requirements.condition: When implementing the experimental MR resource record type.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent MR RDATA as a single NEWNAME field.
requirements.why_checkable: The MR RDATA parser and serializer can be checked for the single-field layout shown in the format diagram.

requirements.quote:
3.3.8. MR RDATA format (EXPERIMENTAL)

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                   NEWNAME                     /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

NEWNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is the
                proper rename of the specified mailbox.
requirements.condition: When implementing the experimental MR resource record type.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode and interpret the MR NEWNAME field as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The MR RDATA field type and domain-name parsing and serialization can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
3.3.8. MR RDATA format (EXPERIMENTAL)

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                   NEWNAME                     /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

NEWNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is the
                proper rename of the specified mailbox.
requirements.condition: When implementing the experimental MR resource record type.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret NEWNAME as the mailbox that is the proper rename of the mailbox specified by the MR record.
requirements.why_checkable: A record with distinct original and replacement mailbox names allows checking the semantic interpretation of NEWNAME.

MR records cause no additional section processing.
requirements.condition: When implementing the experimental MR resource record type.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Cause additional section processing as a result of an MR record.
requirements.why_checkable: MR record handling can be inspected or exercised to determine whether it triggers additional section processing.
